subject: Dashboard completely down for our whole team
body: Since about 20 minutes ago every user in our org gets a 502 when loading the dashboard. We run our morning dispatch from it and 40 drivers are idle.

subject: API returning 500 on every request
body: All calls to /v2/orders started failing with internal server errors an hour ago. Our storefront checkout depends on this endpoint. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Customer data showing in wrong account
body: One of our agents opened a ticket view and saw records that belong to a different company. Screenshot attached. This looks like a serious data leak, please advise immediately.

subject: Invoices charged twice this morning
body: Our customers are reporting duplicate charges from last night's billing run. We've confirmed at least 30 duplicates so far. We need this stopped and refunded today.

subject: Webhook secret possibly leaked
body: A contractor accidentally committed our webhook signing secret to a public repo. How do we rotate it right now, and can you check for suspicious deliveries in the last 24h?

subject: All exports producing empty files
body: Every CSV export since yesterday evening comes back as a 0-byte file. We have a regulatory filing due tomorrow morning that depends on this data.

subject: Login broken after enabling SSO
body: We switched on SAML this afternoon and now nobody can log in, including admins. The fallback password login is also rejecting us. 200 seats locked out.

subject: Payment page throwing errors during our launch
body: We launched our annual sale an hour ago and roughly half of checkout attempts fail with a gateway error from your payment component. We are losing orders every minute.

subject: Sync deleted records instead of updating them
body: The Salesforce sync ran at 02:00 and appears to have deleted ~1,200 contact records on our side instead of updating them. Do you keep backups? We need these restored.

subject: Suspicious admin login from unknown IP
body: Our audit log shows an admin login from an IP in a country where we have no staff, at 3am local. We've disabled the account. Can you confirm what actions were taken in that session?

subject: Production API keys revoked by mistake
body: A teammate revoked our live API keys thinking they were test keys. All our production traffic is now failing auth. Can we restore the old keys or fast-track new ones?

subject: Scheduled reports never arrived and board meeting is at 9
body: The nightly report email that feeds our board pack didn't arrive for any recipient. Manual re-run also fails with a timeout. Meeting is in 3 hours.

subject: Rate limits suddenly 10x lower
body: Since this morning we're being throttled at what looks like a tenth of our contracted rate limit and our pipeline is stalling. No plan changes on our end.

subject: Mobile app crashes on open for every user after update
body: Since your 4.2 release this morning the app crashes on launch for our entire field team. They log deliveries with it, so paper fallback started already.

subject: GDPR deletion request executed on wrong user
body: We submitted a deletion for user A and it appears user B's account and history were purged instead. B is an active paying customer. Need restoration and an incident summary.

subject: Checkout works but orders not appearing anywhere
body: Customers are paying and getting confirmation emails, but the orders don't appear in the dashboard or the API. We're blind to what we've sold since noon.

subject: Certificate expired on custom domain
body: Our white-label portal at portal.ourbrand.com is showing certificate errors to all our clients since midnight. Browsers block the page entirely.

subject: Bulk import corrupted product prices
body: This morning's catalog import set thousands of prices to 0.01. Some items already sold at that price. We've paused the store; need the import reversed urgently.

subject: 2FA codes not being delivered
body: SMS one-time codes stopped arriving for everyone about an hour ago, and anyone whose session expires is locked out. Half our support team can't get in.

subject: Search returns no results on some queries
body: Product search returns empty for queries containing an ampersand. Other queries work. Customers can still browse categories, but this is hurting conversions.

subject: Webhooks arriving twice occasionally
body: Maybe 2% of order webhooks are delivered twice, a few seconds apart. We de-duplicate on our side so no damage, but it started last week and seems new.

subject: CSV export mangles accented characters
body: Names with é and ü come out garbled in exports. Opening with the right encoding fixes it manually, but our ops team trips on this weekly.

subject: Dashboard slow every day around 9am
body: Page loads take 15-20 seconds during our morning peak, versus 2 seconds normally. Usable but painful. Happens daily for the last two weeks.

subject: Zapier trigger fires with 10 minute delay
body: Our new-lead Zap used to fire within seconds; now it's consistently ~10 minutes behind. Not blocking anything, but our SLA to sales is 5 minutes.

subject: Wrong tax rate applied to Quebec invoices
body: Invoices to Quebec customers apply GST only, missing QST. We've caught it before sending this month's batch, but need it fixed before the 15th.

subject: Can't remove former employee from account
body: The remove-user button errors with 'operation failed' for one specific user who left the company. Their access still works. We'd like them out this week.

subject: Sandbox environment out of sync with production schema
body: Our staging integration tests fail because sandbox is missing the new fields you shipped to production. Blocking our release testing, though production itself is fine.

subject: Report totals differ from raw export by ~1%
body: The revenue dashboard widget disagrees with the raw CSV export for the same period. Finance can work from the export but wants to know which one is right.

subject: Email notifications going to spam
body: About half our customers say order confirmations land in spam since last month. We've added your SPF include. Anything else on your side?

subject: Password reset emails delayed 30 minutes
body: Reset emails eventually arrive, but the delay generates support calls for us. Started around the weekend. Everything else is on time.

subject: API pagination skips a record at page boundaries
body: When iterating /v2/customers with per_page=100, the last record of each page is occasionally missing. We can work around with overlapping pages, but it smells like an off-by-one.

subject: Onboarding rollout blocked by CSV template mismatch
body: Your import template changed columns and our HR system's export no longer matches. We planned to onboard 50 seats next Monday. Manual entry is possible but ugly.

subject: Timezone wrong on scheduled reports
body: Reports scheduled for 8am arrive at 8am UTC, not local time as the picker suggests. Recipients get them mid-afternoon. Workaround is setting them 7 hours off.

subject: One user sees stale data until hard refresh
body: A single agent's dashboard shows yesterday's numbers until she hard-refreshes. Other users are fine. Cleared cache, same behavior. Not blocking, just odd.

subject: Invoice PDF misses our purchase order number
body: The PO field we fill in the portal doesn't render on the invoice PDF, so our AP department bounces them back. Re-adding it manually each month works but is tedious.

subject: Intermittent 429s despite being under our limit
body: A few times a day we get rate-limit responses while our dashboards show us at ~60% of quota. Retries succeed. Wondering if burst limits are documented anywhere.

subject: New team member can't access shared views
body: We added an analyst yesterday and shared dashboards don't appear for her despite correct role. Re-sharing individually works as a stopgap.

subject: Billing contact change not saving
body: Updating the billing email in settings appears to save but reverts after logout. Invoices still go to a mailbox of someone on leave; we forward them for now.

subject: Webhook retries exhaust after 3 attempts
body: During our maintenance window we missed webhooks because retries stop after 3 tries in 5 minutes. Can the retry window be extended? We replayed manually this time.

subject: Audit log missing entries for API-initiated changes
body: Changes made via the API don't show in the audit log, only UI changes do. Our compliance review flagged it. Not urgent but we need a story for the auditors next quarter.

subject: Duplicate contacts after HubSpot reconnect
body: Reconnecting the HubSpot integration created duplicates for ~200 contacts instead of matching existing ones. We can merge them by hand, but is there a bulk fix?

subject: Graphs render blank in Safari
body: The analytics charts show empty axes in Safari 18; Chrome is fine. Two of our execs are Safari users. They can use Chrome meanwhile.

subject: Feature request: dark mode for the dashboard
body: Our night-shift team would love a dark theme. Purely cosmetic, but it comes up in every internal survey we run.

subject: Please add CSV alongside XLSX in exports
body: We ingest exports into an old ERP that prefers CSV. XLSX works after conversion, so no rush — just a quality-of-life ask.

subject: Typo in the onboarding checklist
body: Step 3 of the getting-started guide says 'complience'. Tiny thing, thought you'd want to know.

subject: Docs unclear about webhook signature algorithm
body: The docs say 'HMAC' but don't specify SHA-1 vs SHA-256. We figured out it's SHA-256 from the SDK source. Maybe clarify the page?

subject: Can we get quarterly instead of monthly invoices?
body: Our finance team would prefer quarterly billing to reduce PO overhead. No deadline, just checking if it's possible on our plan.

subject: Request: bulk-edit tags on tickets
body: Editing tags one ticket at a time is slow when we re-categorize. A multi-select bulk action would save us an hour a week.

subject: Logo appears slightly stretched on invoice PDF
body: Our logo renders a bit distorted on generated invoices. Customers haven't complained; it just bugs our brand manager.

subject: How do I export only archived projects?
body: Couldn't find a filter for archived-only in exports. Is there a trick, or should I filter after exporting? No rush.

subject: Suggestion: keyboard shortcuts cheat sheet
body: I keep forgetting the shortcuts. A ? overlay listing them like Gmail has would be neat.

subject: Add Slovak to supported languages?
body: We have a small team in Bratislava who'd appreciate a Slovak UI. English works fine for them meanwhile.

subject: API docs example uses deprecated endpoint
body: The quickstart example calls /v1/orders which the changelog says is deprecated. It still works, but new devs on our team keep copying it.

subject: Want webhook event for 'project archived'
body: We'd like to trigger cleanup automation when a project is archived. Currently we poll nightly, which is fine, just not elegant.

subject: Monthly usage email: can more people receive it?
body: Only the account owner gets the usage summary email. Adding our ops alias would be handy. Low priority.

subject: Rounded corners inconsistent across cards
body: Some dashboard cards have 8px radius, others 4px. Design nitpick from our UX person. Feel free to ignore.

subject: Question about data residency options
body: Prospective question: do you offer EU-only data residency? We're evaluating for a future project, nothing contractual yet.

subject: Sandbox test data reset schedule?
body: Does sandbox data reset automatically, or persist forever? Just planning our test fixtures. Docs don't say.

subject: Feature request: duplicate a report configuration
body: Setting up similar reports repeatedly is tedious. A 'duplicate' button on report configs would help. We manage fine without it.

subject: Praise + tiny ask: remember table sort order
body: Love the new tables. One small thing — they forget my sort order between visits. Cookie-level persistence would be lovely.

subject: Old blog link in app footer 404s
body: The 'What's new' footer link goes to a blog post that 404s. Cosmetic, but looks unpolished.

subject: Whitepaper mentions SOC 2 — where's the report?
body: Your site mentions SOC 2 Type II. Could we get the report under NDA for our vendor review? Review is next month.

subject: Integration wishlist: Notion
body: Any plans for a Notion integration? We'd use it for publishing weekly summaries. Zapier covers us for now.

subject: Trial extension request
body: Our evaluation got delayed by an internal reorg. Could we extend the trial two weeks? No blocker, we just want fair testing time.

subject: Increase attachment size limit?
body: 10MB per attachment is tight for our CAD files. We currently share links instead, which works. Higher limit would be convenient.

subject: Dashboard header overlaps menu on small screens
body: On a 13-inch laptop at 125% zoom the header slightly overlaps the nav menu. Everything still clickable. Just reporting.

subject: Export naming convention request
body: Exports download as export-123456.csv. Including the report name and date in the filename would save us renaming them.

subject: Do you have a status page RSS feed?
body: We'd like to pipe your status page into our ops channel. Is there an RSS/webhook option? Email subscriptions work meanwhile.

subject: Billing portal shows company name with old spelling
body: We rebranded from 'Acme Corp' to 'Acme'. The invoices update fine, but the portal header still shows the old name. Cosmetic.

subject: API SDK: TypeScript types out of date
body: The TS SDK types are missing the new webhook fields, so we cast to any. Annoying but not blocking. An updated release would be appreciated.

subject: Access review export for compliance
body: For our annual access review we need a list of users and roles. The members page shows it but we'd love a one-click export. Deadline is in six weeks.
